The article covers 15 events across the full 2026 Milan tech calendar, organized chronologically with a table and detailed notes on each upcoming event. Key findings: May 2026 was the density peak (AI Week, ETHMilan, AWS Summit, Google Cloud AI Live, ItaliaSec all within 10 days); from today's date (June 2), the next conference is ECIS (June 15–17, academic) then AI Conf (June 24, €99, Italian-language), followed by Codemotion (Oct 28–29, €179, broadest developer event) and Cloud Day (Nov 18, €49, vendor-neutral cloud).
